Hello,

I'm pleased to announce that we have enhanced our response time for questions and reported issues, thanks to the diligent efforts of Jeung-Hyun Lee and Eunhwi Lee from the CCS Lab.

A special thanks to Jeung-Hyun and Eunhwi for their dedication, and to all of you for your continued interest in the hBayesDM package. Should you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
